title: Venezuelan Cheese Sandwich
description: A simple and flavorful sandwich recipe with a Venezuelan twist, featuring melted cheese and a crispy crust.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Butter one side of each slice of sandwich bread.
Place one slice, buttered side down, in the pan.
Sprinkle Venezuelan cheese on top of the bread in the pan.
Add a dash of jubilant and juicy on top of the cheese.
Place the second slice of bread, buttered side up, on top of the filling.
Cook until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Flip the sandwich over and cook the other side until it's also golden brown.
